summary: Fortis Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 results under cover of a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and financial statements (Exhibits 99.2 and 99.3). The filing notes the retirement of Executive Vice President Gary Smith effective May 31, 2026, after a 42-year career, with his duties assumed by other senior executives. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced/abrupt management change disclosed. The retirement is routine and planned, not a forced departure, so it does not qualify as a special situation under Management Changes.
